title: The surprising implications of culture on language and how we talk

blocks.en_text: What images come to your mind
blocks.zh_text: 你脑海中会浮现出哪些画面

blocks.en_text: when you see or hear the word “culture?”
blocks.zh_text: 当你看到或听到“文化”这个词的时候？

blocks.en_text: If you were to ask me personally, I would say food,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你问我个人的话，我会说是美食，

blocks.en_text: because who doesn’t love to bond over a great meal?
blocks.zh_text: 因为谁不喜欢在一顿美餐中拉近彼此的距离呢？

blocks.en_text: But have you thought about the implications
blocks.zh_text: 但你想过吗，

blocks.en_text: of culture on language,
blocks.zh_text: 文化对语言的影响，

blocks.en_text: and more importantly, how culture can impact our everyday communication?
blocks.zh_text: 更重要的是，文化如何影响我们日常的交流？

blocks.en_text: Just by a show of hands, how many of you speak a language other than English
blocks.zh_text: 我们举个手看看，有多少人会讲英语以外的语言，

blocks.en_text: or know someone who does?
blocks.zh_text: 或者认识这样的人？

blocks.en_text: Take a moment to look around you,
blocks.zh_text: 花点时间看看你周围，

blocks.en_text: because almost all of you have raised your hand.
blocks.zh_text: 因为几乎所有人都举手了。

blocks.en_text: Having grown up both within the United States and Iran,
blocks.zh_text: 我在美国和伊朗两地长大，

blocks.en_text: I have been exposed to two very different and unique ways of life
blocks.zh_text: 接触过两种截然不同、各具特色的生活方式，

blocks.en_text: each with their own distinct culture.
blocks.zh_text: 每一种都有自己独特的文化。

blocks.en_text: But it was only when I started to teach English in Iran
blocks.zh_text: 但直到我开始在伊朗教英语，

blocks.en_text: that I began to understand
blocks.zh_text: 我才开始理解

blocks.en_text: the dynamic relationship between culture and language.
blocks.zh_text: 文化与语言之间那种动态的关系。

blocks.en_text: Culture can impact what we communicate verbally and non-verbally.
blocks.zh_text: 文化会影响我们用言语和非言语方式传达的内容。

blocks.en_text: And to demonstrate that to you today, I’d like to reflect
blocks.zh_text: 为了今天向大家说明这一点，我想回顾一下

blocks.en_text: on some of my English language teaching experiences.
blocks.zh_text: 我的一些英语教学经历。

blocks.en_text: You can understand the shock on my face when my student addressed me as master.
blocks.zh_text: 你能想象当我的学生称呼我“师父”时，我脸上有多震惊。

blocks.en_text: For a second, I didn’t know how to respond.
blocks.zh_text: 有那么一瞬间，我不知道该怎么回应。

blocks.en_text: Was this a scene from Karate Kid?
blocks.zh_text: 这是《龙威小子》里的场景吗？

blocks.en_text: Was I master Miyagi, and my student Daniel-san?
blocks.zh_text: 我是宫城师父，而我的学生是丹尼尔吗？

blocks.en_text: Wax on, wax off.
blocks.zh_text: 打蜡，擦蜡。

blocks.en_text: However, with the help of one of my colleagues,
blocks.zh_text: 不过，在我一位同事的帮助下，

blocks.en_text: I came to understand that one of the Persian words for teacher
blocks.zh_text: 我渐渐明白，波斯语中表示“老师”的一个词

blocks.en_text: when translated to English has a similar definition to master,
blocks.zh_text: 翻译成英语后，含义和“师父”相似，

blocks.en_text: highlighting and signifying the high degree of respect
blocks.zh_text: 凸显并象征着学生对他或她的老师

blocks.en_text: a student holds for his or her teacher.
blocks.zh_text: 所怀有的高度敬意。

blocks.en_text: Or another time when after a long and stressful day of teaching,
blocks.zh_text: 还有一次，在漫长而压力山大的一天教学之后，

blocks.en_text: my students stopped me
blocks.zh_text: 我的学生们拦住我，

blocks.en_text: and said in the calmest and smoothest of voices,
blocks.zh_text: 用最平静、最柔和的声音说：

blocks.en_text: “Don’t be tired.”
blocks.zh_text: “别累了。”

blocks.en_text: I wasn't sure what to make of that.
blocks.zh_text: 我不太确定该怎么理解这句话。

blocks.en_text: Was I being encouraged or mocked because of my teaching efforts?
blocks.zh_text: 这是在鼓励我，还是在嘲讽我的教学付出？

blocks.en_text: When I told a colleague of mine,
blocks.zh_text: 当我告诉一位同事时，

blocks.en_text: she said that the statement that my student had uttered
blocks.zh_text: 她说我学生说的那句话

blocks.en_text: was similar to a simple “thank you” in the English language.
blocks.zh_text: 相当于英语里一句简单的“谢谢”。

blocks.en_text: However, it differed in that the connotation of the expression
blocks.zh_text: 不过，不同之处在于这个表达的内涵

blocks.en_text: underlined the mental and physical efforts
blocks.zh_text: 强调的是我那天在课堂上

blocks.en_text: that I had put into class that day.
blocks.zh_text: 所付出的脑力和体力。

blocks.en_text: Now culture is not only limited to verbal modes of communication
blocks.zh_text: 文化不仅限于语言交流方式

blocks.en_text: but can also impact nonverbal communication as well.
blocks.zh_text: 也会影响非语言交流。

blocks.en_text: Think about body gestures for a second.
blocks.zh_text: 想想肢体动作。

blocks.en_text: Let’s say that you and I were having a conversation,
blocks.zh_text: 假设你和我正在聊天，

blocks.en_text: much like the one that we’re having right now,
blocks.zh_text: 就像我们现在这样，

blocks.en_text: and I decided to fold my arms.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我决定把双臂交叉抱起来。

blocks.en_text: What would you make of that?
blocks.zh_text: 你会怎么理解？

blocks.en_text: For one, it could mean that I'm cold.
blocks.zh_text: 一方面，这可能意味着我冷了。

blocks.en_text: But what could it potentially reveal about my personality?
blocks.zh_text: 但它可能揭示出我性格的什么特点呢？

blocks.en_text: Here in the United States,
blocks.zh_text: 在美国这里，

blocks.en_text: folding your arms is associated with being unfriendly,
blocks.zh_text: 抱臂被认为是不友好、

blocks.en_text: distant or standoffish.
blocks.zh_text: 疏远或冷淡的表现。

blocks.en_text: But what if I told you that the same exact body gesture
blocks.zh_text: 但如果我告诉你，完全相同的肢体动作

blocks.en_text: has a completely different connotation in another environment,
blocks.zh_text: 在另一个环境里有着完全不同的含义，

blocks.en_text: like East Asia and the Middle East?
blocks.zh_text: 比如东亚和中东呢？

blocks.en_text: In that context,
blocks.zh_text: 在那种语境下，

blocks.en_text: folding your arms is a sign of contemplation and wisdom,
blocks.zh_text: 抱臂是沉思和智慧的标志，

blocks.en_text: indicating that you are wholeheartedly thinking about what has been said to you
blocks.zh_text: 表示你在全心全意地思考对方说的话

blocks.en_text: to provide the best possible response.
blocks.zh_text: 以便给出最好的回应。

blocks.en_text: Now oftentimes there are even cultural concepts and notions
blocks.zh_text: 而且很多时候，甚至有些文化概念和观念

blocks.en_text: that are virtually nonexistent in another environment.
blocks.zh_text: 在另一个环境里几乎不存在。

blocks.en_text: Take, for instance, the Persian cultural concept of “tarof.”
blocks.zh_text: 比如波斯文化中的“tarof”概念。

blocks.en_text: Simply put, “tarof” is a staple and integral part of the Persian culture,
blocks.zh_text: 简单来说，“tarof”是波斯文化的基本组成部分，

blocks.en_text: emphasizing polite gestures and cultural pleasantries
blocks.zh_text: 强调礼貌举止和文化客套

blocks.en_text: in a wide array of situations.
blocks.zh_text: 在各种场合中。

blocks.en_text: And here’s what it looks like.
blocks.zh_text: 它是这样的。

blocks.en_text: For me going out to eat looks very different,
blocks.zh_text: 对我来说，出去吃饭的情况很不一样，

blocks.en_text: depending on whether I’m with my Persian or non-Persian friends.
blocks.zh_text: 取决于我是和波斯朋友还是非波斯朋友在一起。

blocks.en_text: With my non-Persian friends,
blocks.zh_text: 和我的非波斯朋友在一起时，

blocks.en_text: it’s a very peaceful and tranquil experience.
blocks.zh_text: 那是非常平静安宁的体验。

blocks.en_text: When the bill comes, everyone pays for the meal they had separately,
blocks.zh_text: 账单来了，大家各付各的，

blocks.en_text: and we leave.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我们就走了。

blocks.en_text: However, it’s a completely different story when I’m out with my Persian friends.
blocks.zh_text: 然而，和波斯朋友出去就完全是另一回事了。

blocks.en_text: It’s a battlefield
blocks.zh_text: 那是一场战场，

blocks.en_text: as we try to snatch the bill from the waiter
blocks.zh_text: 我们争着从服务员手里抢账单，

blocks.en_text: to proclaim victorious in paying for everyone.
blocks.zh_text: 好宣布自己胜利地为所有人付了钱。

blocks.en_text: Now this might seem strange,
blocks.zh_text: 这看起来可能很奇怪，

blocks.en_text: but this is a sign of hospitality within the Persian culture,
blocks.zh_text: 但这是波斯文化中好客的表现，

blocks.en_text: indicating that you have greatly enjoyed the other person’s presence,
blocks.zh_text: 表示你非常享受对方的陪伴，

blocks.en_text: and they are your guest for the meal.
blocks.zh_text: 对方是你这顿饭的客人。

blocks.en_text: This can even go to extremes as we arrive earlier at a restaurant
blocks.zh_text: 这甚至可以做到极端，我们会提前到餐厅

blocks.en_text: just to provide a credit card,
blocks.zh_text: 只是为了先交一张信用卡，

blocks.en_text: so our guest has absolutely no chance of paying.
blocks.zh_text: 这样我们的客人就完全没机会付钱。

blocks.en_text: So take it from me.
blocks.zh_text: 所以听我的。

blocks.en_text: Make sure you have some Persian friends.
blocks.zh_text: 一定要交几个波斯朋友。

blocks.en_text: That way, you’ll never have to pick up the bill.
blocks.zh_text: 这样，你就永远不用买单了。

blocks.en_text: Cultural concepts such as “tarof” are even more difficult to grasp
blocks.zh_text: 像“tarof”这样的文化概念更难理解

blocks.en_text: for individuals not familiar with the context.
blocks.zh_text: 对于不熟悉这个背景的人来说。

blocks.en_text: So you can imagine the puzzling look on my European friend’s face
blocks.zh_text: 所以你可以想象我那位欧洲朋友脸上困惑的表情

blocks.en_text: when he came to Iran for the first time,
blocks.zh_text: 当他第一次来伊朗的时候，

blocks.en_text: and the cab driver told him that he didn’t have to pay the fare,
blocks.zh_text: 出租车司机告诉他不用付车费，

blocks.en_text: saying something along the lines of,
blocks.zh_text: 说的是类似这样的话：

blocks.en_text: “It’s not worthy of you.”
blocks.zh_text: “这配不上您。”

blocks.en_text: Next thing you know, the same cab driver is shouting and yelling at him,
blocks.zh_text: 结果你猜怎么着，同一个出租车司机又冲他大喊大叫，

blocks.en_text: “Where do you think you’re going, pal? You forgot to pay the fare.”
blocks.zh_text: “你以为你往哪儿走呢，哥们儿？你忘了付车费了。”

blocks.en_text: My friend, unaware of the cultural concept of “tarof,”
blocks.zh_text: 我朋友不了解“tarof”这个文化概念，

blocks.en_text: solely relied on his understanding of language,
blocks.zh_text: 只凭自己对语言的理解，

blocks.en_text: which led him to literally take the offer.
blocks.zh_text: 结果就字面意思地接受了这个免单。

blocks.en_text: However, it is this cultural knowledge that makes it known
blocks.zh_text: 然而，正是这种文化知识让人明白

blocks.en_text: that it’s customary for service personnel to refuse payment two or three times
blocks.zh_text: 服务人员习惯性地拒绝收钱两三次

blocks.en_text: as a sign of hospitality
blocks.zh_text: 以表示好客

blocks.en_text: all while expecting the payment to be completed in the end.
blocks.zh_text: 但同时又期望最后钱还是照付。

blocks.en_text: Now keep in mind,
blocks.zh_text: 现在请记住，

blocks.en_text: all of the examples that we have talked about today
blocks.zh_text: 我们今天谈到的所有例子

blocks.en_text: represent a very microskill
blocks.zh_text: 都只代表一个非常微小的技能点

blocks.en_text: of the present-day multiculturalism that exists.
blocks.zh_text: 在当今存在的多元文化中。

blocks.en_text: Currently, there are around 1.35 billion English speakers around the world.
blocks.zh_text: 目前，全世界大约有13.5亿英语使用者。

blocks.en_text: Out of which around 1 billion also speak a language other than English,
blocks.zh_text: 其中大约有10亿人还会说英语以外的另一种语言，

blocks.en_text: which consciously and unconsciously brings with itself cultural norms and perceptions
blocks.zh_text: 这会有意无意地带来文化规范和观念

blocks.en_text: which may influence and impact their English communication.
blocks.zh_text: 这些可能会影响和作用于他们的英语交流。

blocks.en_text: And the United States is a wonderful example of a multicultural environment.
blocks.zh_text: 而美国就是一个多元文化环境的绝佳例子。

blocks.en_text: As of 2018, there are around 67 million individuals
blocks.zh_text: 截至2018年，大约有6700万人

blocks.en_text: who speak a language other than English right here.
blocks.zh_text: 就在这里说英语以外的语言。

blocks.en_text: Now you might be asking yourself: Why is any of this important?
blocks.zh_text: 现在你可能会问自己：这些为什么重要？

blocks.en_text: Well firstly, fostering and developing an appreciation
blocks.zh_text: 首先，培养和发展一种认识，

blocks.en_text: that each and every single culture
blocks.zh_text: 即每一种文化

blocks.en_text: brings something to this table called life.
blocks.zh_text: 都为这个叫做生活的东西贡献了一份力量。

blocks.en_text: And secondly, for me personally,
blocks.zh_text: 其次，对我个人而言，

blocks.en_text: this is important because, as an English language instructor
blocks.zh_text: 这很重要，因为作为一名英语教师

blocks.en_text: and doctoral student here at Texas A&M,
blocks.zh_text: 以及德州农工大学的博士生，

blocks.en_text: I feel responsible for paying forward this knowledge
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得有责任把这份知识传递下去

blocks.en_text: to the future generation of educators
blocks.zh_text: 传给未来的教育工作者

blocks.en_text: so that they not only know
blocks.zh_text: 让他们不仅知道

blocks.en_text: what to provide in the classroom in terms of the language
blocks.zh_text: 在课堂上要提供什么样的语言内容

blocks.en_text: that is accurate and appropriate
blocks.zh_text: 才是准确和恰当的

blocks.en_text: but also take into context the richness and culture
blocks.zh_text: 还要考虑到这些人的丰富性和文化

blocks.en_text: that these individuals possess.
blocks.zh_text: 他们所拥有的。

blocks.en_text: Which brings the question:
blocks.zh_text: 这就引出了一个问题：

blocks.en_text: What can we do when the landscape is so rich?
blocks.zh_text: 当情况如此丰富多样时，我们能做些什么？

blocks.en_text: Realistically and practically speaking,
blocks.zh_text: 现实地、实际地讲，

blocks.en_text: we cannot be expected to know every single thing there is
blocks.zh_text: 我们不能指望自己知道存在的每一件事

blocks.en_text: about the wide array of cultures that exist.
blocks.zh_text: 关于世界上存在的各种各样的文化。

blocks.en_text: But if there’s one thing
blocks.zh_text: 但如果有一件事

blocks.en_text: that I would like for you to take away from this talk today, it’s this:
blocks.zh_text: 是我希望大家今天听完这场演讲后能记住的，那就是：

blocks.en_text: That just because individuals act and say things
blocks.zh_text: 仅仅因为有些人的言行

blocks.en_text: that may slightly differ from our norms and perceptions
blocks.zh_text: 可能和我们的规范与认知稍有不同

blocks.en_text: does not mean that they are wrong, and we are right.
blocks.zh_text: 并不意味着他们就是错的，我们就是对的。

blocks.en_text: Rather, it offers a different lens and perspective of looking into life,
blocks.zh_text: 相反，这提供了一种看待生活的不同视角和眼光，

blocks.en_text: one that you and I might be interested in learning a little bit more about.
blocks.zh_text: 一种你我也许会有兴趣多了解一点的视角。

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢大家。
